title: incident-bot: improve oncall diagnostics, runbook linking, and SLO hints
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Enhances incident-bot oncall diagnostics: improved runbook linking, SLO hinting/scoring, and telemetry enrichment. Non-breaking. Expected reduction in MTTR for common SLO alerts.
description: Motivation: Oncall flow for SREs relies on incident-bot to surface actionable diagnostics and runbook links. Current signals are noisy and runbook linking misses context for multi-service SLOs. This PR improves the diagnostics pipeline with SLO-aware hinting, contextual runbook scoring, and additional telemetry tags for post-incident analysis. Key changes: - Add SLO hint scorer that weights hints by breach likelihood, recent error spike, and traffic impact. - Improve runbook linker to include service-level and SLO-context filters; rank runbooks by relevance score. - Emit telemetry tags on diagnostics (slo_id, hint_score, runbook_match_score, sample_id) for downstream analysis and alerts. - Add small UX updates to oncall messages: condensed summary, top-3 suggested runbooks, and explicit fallback instructions. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for scorer and linker - [x] Integration test for oncall message formatting - [x] Telemetry schema update + migration guide - [x] Docs updated with new oncall message format - [x] Load test run on perf-canary (no regressions) Backwards compatibility: The oncall message includes a compatibility flag; existing consumers will ignore new telemetry tags. Deployment plan: Gradual rollout by region with feature flag and canary targeting 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h. Rollback: toggle feature flag to off. Related: ENG-2134, SRE-59, SUP-1234.

review_comments: Connor Li: Please add a short doc comment describing the hint scoring formula and expected score range. Author: Added formula and unit tests covering edge cases.
Marta Kovacs: Can we avoid extra RTT in the hot path? Suggest caching runbook metadata in-memory. Author: Implemented a small LRU cache with 1k entries and added metrics for cache hit rate.
Diego Fernandez: Telemetry tags look good but ensure we don't leak PII. Author: Redacted any user identifiers and added schema validation to CI.
SRE rotation: Ran perf-canary and saw no latency regression at p95; minor increase at p99 (+3ms) within SLA. Author: Tuned cache TTL and reduced p99 delta.
